name: A Lack of Virtue

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler passing through Menethil Harbor, you may find Bart Tidewater barking orders at his crew. The delivery makes a quick detour while you wait for transport across the Great Sea.

aliases: who is captain of the maidens virtue
faq.answer: Bart Tidewater calls himself captain of the Maiden's Virtue, docked in Menethil Harbor. Tom Half-fish says Bart was an actor who bought the ship with poker winnings, though each man accuses the other of cheating.

aliases: who gives a lack of virtue
faq.answer: Tom Half-fish is an old acquaintance of Bart Tidewater who gives travelers a gift to carry across the sea to Bart. He bears a fierce grudge against the captain and calls him a fraud, a cheapskate, and a card cheat.
The Maiden's Virtue is a vessel docked in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Bart calls it the finest ship in the Great Sea, while Tom claims it has sailed only as far as a rock in Tanaris.

aliases: why does bart get mad at toms gift
faq.answer: Tom's Gift is a package Tom Half-fish sends to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor. The courier does not know what's inside, but its arrival prompts Bart to angrily accuse Tom of cheating at poker.

Both sailors accuse the other of cheating. Tom Half-fish says Bart was an actor who cheated at poker to win enough for his ship. Bart says he won it honestly after expelling Tom from their poker circle for cheating.

aliases: how do i get to menethil harbor
faq.answer: You can reach Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands by ship across the Great Sea. Tom says a direct boat service stops at the harbor on its second stop.
faq.q: How do you deliver the gift to Menethil Harbor?

sections.body: Tom Half-fish asks you to carry a parcel across the water to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor. The delivery is meant to sting his former companion. Tom says Bart is no true sea dog, but an actor who cheated at cards to buy his command.
sections.title: A Bitter Grudge

sections.body: When Tom's Gift reaches Bart Tidewater on the docks of Menethil Harbor, Bart rages at the mention of his old associate. He says Tom cheated at cards, and that he bought the Maiden's Virtue only after their poker circle banished Half-fish. Soon Bart catches himself. He apologizes for snapping at the courier and welcomes you to the harbor.
sections.title: Cards on the Table

summary: Tom Half-fish sends a parcel across the sea to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor. Their old quarrel over cards and the Maiden's Virtue now reaches a traveler carrying it.
